summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called dapagliflozin to see how it affects liver health in adults who have type 2 diabetes and nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, a condition where fat builds up in the liver. Participants are given either the study drug, a placebo which is an inactive substance, or a negative control over a period of 6 months. The trial has an enrollment of 60 participants and is sponsored by Amira Bisher,PhD.
